text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: ...Little brother! Thank you so much for choosing me! Big Sis is so happy, I feel like I might just burst!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
弟くん！　
選んでくれて
本当にありがとうっ！
お姉ちゃん、
うれしすぎてどうにかなっちゃいそうだよ！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I've decided that starting today, I'm not holding anything back anymore! So you'd better spoil yourself rotten and rely on me as much as you want, okay? No matter what happens, no matter how far we go... Big Sis will wrap you up and take care of absolutely everything♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうね、
今日からは一切我慢しないって決めたよ！
だから、
弟くんも思いっきり甘えて、
いっぱい頼ってね？
どこまでも、
どこまでも、
ぜ～んぶ包み込んであげる♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Aaah...♪ I'm overflowing with love for you...! I can't hold back this overwhelming urge to squeeze you tight...! I wish I could make every single one of these feelings reach you, little brother...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ……♪　
愛しさがあふれちゃう……！
ぎゅっと抱きしめたい気持ちが
抑えられないよ……！
この想い、
全部弟くんに届けばいいのに……！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Before... there were many times when I couldn't be there for you. Times where watching was all I could do...
text_block_list.orig_text:
前は……
弟くんのそばにいてあげられないことも多くて。
見守ることしかできない時もあったんだ……

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: That's why I came up with "Big Sis Stealth", and secretly took care of you without letting you notice. Hehe, those were the good old days♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで
「お姉ちゃんステルス」なんて言って、
気づかれないように弟くんのお世話をしてたの。
ふふっ、
懐かしいなぁ♪

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: But... I'm not going to hide anymore. After all, you chose me, little brother.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
もう隠れたりしない。
だって弟くんが、
お姉ちゃんを選んでくれたから。

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Your kindness, your strength, your tears, and your smiles... Big Sis knows all about them. So I'm going to love you and protect you with absolutely everything I have, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
弟くんの
優しさも、
強さも、
涙も
笑顔も、
お姉ちゃんは全部知ってるよ。
だから私も、
負けないくらい全力で愛して守るね！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I swear it right here and now. As your Big Sis... and as your partner! No matter what happens, I'll absolutely, positively make you happy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今
ここで誓うよ。
お姉ちゃんとして、
そして、
パートナーとして……
何があっても、
絶対
ぜ～ったい、
あなたを幸せにするって！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: Come on, hold my hand tight, okay? Through the happy times and the difficult ones, from now on, we'll walk forward together. No matter what the future brings, as long as we're together, everything will be okay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
ぎゅって手を握って？
楽しい時も、
苦しい時も、
これからは二人で歩もうね。
どんな未来も、
二人なら絶対大丈夫！

text_block_list.name: Shizuru
text_block_list.text: I love you more than anyone else in the whole world, little brother. So stay with your Big Sis forever and ever, okay♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界でいちばん大好きだよ、
弟くん。
これからも、
ずっとお姉ちゃんと一緒にいようね♪
